description: Estimates what a parking provider could charge for a parking space (monthly and weekly range, suggested daily and hourly price) at a place, and links to list the space on Parksy. Use this when someone asks what a garage, driveway or parking space is worth, could earn or should charge. Add the country when a place name is common. An estimate only.

country.description: Optional two-letter country code, for example AU, US, GB, CA, NZ or IE.

place.description: City, suburb, neighborhood, landmark or address, for example "Surry Hills, Sydney" or "Midtown Manhattan". Add the state or country when a name is common.

postcode.description: Optional postcode or ZIP code for a more local estimate.

secure_access.description: Access needs a key, remote or code.

space_type.description: indoor = garage or undercover, outdoor = driveway or open space.

name: space_value
title: Parking Space Value Estimate
